ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low overall contrast; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels representing less than 5% of the area, concentrated at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across approximately 95% of the visible fluke; small, high-contrast white mottling and focal spots localized at the far lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a defined vertex and an approximate interior angle of 140 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-frequency serration profile along the entire trailing edge; multiple distinct peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature along the outer sweep of both lobes, tapering to acute, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 7-10 distinct circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters on the dorsal-distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the surface of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular rosette scarring on the right lobe tip; significantly jagged and irregular trailing edge topography suggesting cumulative physical wear.
